accepted_callback_false.note: Aggregate of callback absent or callback returning false; not one source branch.

accepted_callback_true.note: Aggregate alias for callback present and true.

airborne_backward_motion.note: Nonzero movement with negative signed age witnesses use of absolute duration for motion.

airborne_even.note: Even reads the odd slot and eventually replaces the even slot unless returned early.

airborne_odd.note: Odd reads the even slot and eventually replaces the odd slot unless returned early.

backward_speed_above_threshold.note: Nonzero backward-time movement above 1200 km/h rejects; missing abs would accept.

backward_speed_below_threshold.note: Nonzero backward-time movement at or below 1200 km/h passes; targeted fixtures must be strictly below.

cache_replace_accepted.note: Accepted candidate updates public state then replaces its parity cache.

cache_replace_failed.note: No accepted candidate; public position is preserved but its parity cache is replaced.

cache_unchanged_early_return.note: Same event as cross_parity_out_of_order; state/cache preservation is checked.

callback_false.note: A supplied callback returns false and leaves shared reference unchanged.

callback_true.note: A supplied callback returns true and updates shared reference.

cross_parity_out_of_order.note: Negative time relative to the opposite slot returns before any state update.

decode_rejected.note: Message::from_bytes failed; the batch skips the missing message.

distance_above_500.note: Distance context only; does not by itself imply jump rejection.

distance_below_500.note: Distance context only; speed rejection or age can prevent the jump condition from evaluating.

distance_exact_500.note: Exact distance boundary context; not required because no exact binary64 fixture is assumed.

global_rejected.note: airborne_position returns None, so the local-age condition is considered.

global_success.note: airborne_position returns Some, so the local fallback is skipped.

jump_rejection.note: Candidate survives speed but exceeds 500 km with absolute age below 30 seconds.

local_age_exact.note: Exactly 180 seconds fails the signed local-age condition.

local_age_inside.note: The signed age is strictly less than 180 seconds, including negative ages.

local_age_outside.note: Greater than 180 seconds fails the same signed condition.

local_attempt.note: A previous accepted position exists for local fallback.

local_no_previous_position.note: No previous accepted position exists for local fallback.

motion_pass.note: After surviving speed validation, the compound jump-rejection condition is false; its conjuncts are not counted separately.

non_adsb.note: A successfully decoded frame has no tracking dispatch.

opposite_slot_empty.note: The opposite slot is None, so global reconstruction has no candidate.

other_adsb.note: The other-ME arm records supported evidence and produces no position.

pair_even_then_odd.note: The odd parity arm with a populated even slot; not another decision.

pair_gap_exact.note: Exactly 30 seconds fails the strict pair window.

pair_gap_inside.note: The strict absolute 30-second pair window passes after the ordering check.

pair_gap_outside.note: More than 30 seconds fails the same strict pair-window condition.

pair_odd_then_even.note: The even parity arm with a populated odd slot; not another decision.

reference_initialized.note: A true callback changed None to Some; initialization is not a separate source branch.

reference_unchanged.note: Can result from early return, failure, absent/false callback, unchanged coordinates, or non-airborne message.

reference_updated.note: A true callback changed an existing coordinate; source uses the same assignment.

resolved.note: Aggregate accepted position across airborne and surface paths.

same_parity_out_of_order_replacement.note: Only the opposite timestamp is checked; replacement of an older same-parity slot is permitted.

signed_local_age_backward_motion.note: A negative age permits local fallback; targeted fixtures at -180 seconds and on both sides test that an absolute-age rule would be wrong.

speed_above_threshold.note: Computed speed greater than 1200 km/h rejects.

speed_below_threshold.note: Computed speed below 1200 km/h does not reject.

speed_exact_threshold.note: Computed speed equal to 1200 km/h does not reject.

speed_gap_inside.note: Absolute age below 1800 seconds enables speed validation.

speed_gap_outside.note: Greater than 1800 seconds bypasses the same condition.

speed_zero_dt.note: Zero absolute duration bypasses division/speed rejection.

surface_airport_lookup_found.note: Lookup result is Some; a result split inside surface_airport.lookup, not another tracking branch.

surface_airport_lookup_missing.note: Lookup result is None; a result split inside surface_airport.lookup, not another tracking branch.

surface_airport_lookup_none.note: No airport was set, so nearest-airport lookup runs.

surface_airport_preserved_despite_new_ne.note: The existing airport is retained even when a fresh lookup would return another airport; no unconditional refresh exists.

surface_airport_preserved_existing.note: An existing airport skips lookup and remains unchanged.

surface_even.note: Surface parity selects the low-level grid; decode_position has no surface parity policy branch.

surface_existing_bypasses_airport.note: Existing position bypasses first-surface airport proximity validation.

surface_first_far_from_airport.note: First position is not within strict 10-km airport proximity and rejected.

surface_first_near_airport.note: First position is within strict 10-km airport proximity and accepted.

surface_has_previous.note: An existing accepted position permits an own-reference attempt.

surface_no_shared_reference.note: No own candidate remains and no shared reference exists.

surface_odd.note: Surface parity selects the low-level grid; decode_position has no surface parity policy branch.

surface_out_of_order.note: No surface timestamp gate exists; a backward timestamp can still update position.

surface_own_1km_just_inside.note: Decoded distance lies in the 2-m band below 1 km; targeted fixtures are additionally required within one latitude code.

surface_own_1km_just_outside.note: Decoded distance lies in the 2-m band at/above 1 km; targeted fixtures are additionally required strictly above and within one latitude code.

surface_own_decode_rejected.note: The own-reference decoder returns None; short circuit skips distance.

surface_own_outside_1km.note: Decoded distance is at least 1 km, so own-reference candidate is discarded.

surface_own_within_1km.note: Decoded distance is strictly below 1 km and the own-reference candidate is retained.

surface_recent_previous.note: Age below 180 seconds is context, not a surface policy branch.

surface_shared_attempt.note: No own candidate remains and a shared reference exists.

surface_stale_previous.note: No surface 180-second age gate exists; this tests absence of an airborne-only rule.

transition_airborne_to_surface_altitude_.note: Accepted surface position resets a nonempty altitude to None; assignment outcome, not a new conditional arm.

transition_surface_to_airborne_airport_c.note: Accepted airborne position clears an existing airport; assignment outcome, not a new conditional arm.

unresolved.note: Aggregate missing position across different policy outcomes.

limitation: Finite recorded strata; not proof of numerical geography, airport database accuracy, or exhaustive streams.
trace_validation: Every sequential decode_position result is asserted bit-identical to actual batch decode_positions. Every airborne shadow candidate is asserted equal to the real output after motion validation; every surface candidate is asserted equal unconditionally. These assertions validate oracle labels, not Lean numeric acceptance: Lean positions pass at 1e-9 degrees, with bit identity only reported.
